ut


def save_webp(arr: np.ndarray, path: Path, quality: int):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    Image.fromarray(arr, "RGB").save(path, "WEBP", quality=quality, method=6)


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--face-size", type=int, default=1024)
    ap.add_argument("--pano-width", type=int, default=4096)
    ap.add_argument("--quality", type=int, default=82)
    ap.add_argument("--output", type=Path, default=Path(__file__).resolve().parent)
    args = ap.parse_args()
    pano_h = args.pano_width // 2
    out = args.output
    scenes = [build_living(), build_entry(), build_park()]
    face_keys = ["px", "nx", "py", "ny", "pz", "nz"]
    manifest = {"version": 2, "generated": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()), "faceSize": args.face_size, "panoSize": [args.pano_width, pano_h], "quality": args.quality, "scenes": []}
    for scene in scenes:
        print(f"Rendering {scene.scene_id}...")
        faces = {}
        face_paths = {}
        scene_start = time.perf_counter()
        for face in face_keys:
            t0 = time.perf_counter()
            img = render_face(scene, face, args.face_size)
            path = out / "assets" / "cubemap" / scene.scene_id / f"{face}.webp"
            save_webp(img, path, args.quality)
            faces[face] = img
            face_paths[face] = {"path": str(path.relative_to(out)).replace(os.sep, "/"), "bytes": path.stat().st_size}
            print(f"  {face}: {time.perf_counter()-t0:.2f}s, {path.stat().st_size/1024:.1f} KiB")
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        pano = render_equirect(scene, args.pano_width, pano_h)
        pano_path = out / "assets" / "equirect" / f"{scene.scene_id}.webp"
        save_webp(pano, pano_path, args.quality)
        print(f"  pano: {time.perf_counter()-t0:.2f}s, {pano_path.stat().st_size/1024:.1f} KiB")
        # contact sheet preview for QA
        preview_path = out / "assets" / f"preview_{scene.scene_id}.jpg"
        Image.fromarray(pano).resize((1600, 800), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS).save(preview_path, quality=88)
        manifest["scenes"].append({
            "id": scene.scene_id,
            "title": scene.title,
            "equirect": {"path": str(pano_path.relative_to(out)).replace(os.sep, "/"), "bytes": pano_path.stat().st_size},
            "cubemap": face_paths,
            "targets": scene.targets,
            "renderSeconds": round(time.perf_counter()-scene_start, 3),
        })
    (out / "assets" / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
